name: Icelandic Transport Authority (Samgöngustofa)
notes: Renamed from is-icetra to is-samgongustofa. Role confirmed on island.is/en/o/transport-authority (reached via icetra.is and samgongustofa.is): 'responsible for the administration and supervision of aviation, maritime and road traffic safety', with an Aviation section. CDN ruling: the logo is a PNG on the Contentful CDN images.ctfassets.net, referenced directly by an on the authority's page (alt 'The Icelandic Transport Authority Frontpage'); the page is served from icetra.is/samgongustofa.is and lands on the Icelandic government portal island.is, so island.is and the CDN host are listed in official_domains (tier 2, website-served). It is the 'S' symbol alone (400x400 RGBA PNG). No logo terms located, so redistribution rights are not confirmed.
